risks.detail: Candidate backup, read-only preflight, runtime parity, one manually authorized recovery, API/data/unit/timer/journal smoke, and rollback evidence completed before merge.
A health domain without an explicit input revision is report-only and exposes a manual blocker; it cannot synthesize a fingerprint from status text or counts.

Manual policy execution must be started through a transient systemd unit with EnvironmentFile=/etc/wow-backend.env. A bare sudo-u process intentionally fails closed because it cannot read the protected runtime environment.
